svg.title: The Ambassador Agent pattern
svg.desc: A core agent opens a task with the ambassador, the only path to an external system. The task passes policy and admission, the ambassador records its intent in the journal and only then acts on the external system. Whatever comes back passes quarantine before the core agent sees it. When too many tasks are waiting, the task is refused. record the intent: Core agent → Policy and admission → Ambassador → Journal. then act and answer: Ambassador → External system → Quarantine → Core agent. refused when full: Core agent → Policy and admission, refused at Policy and admission.
